mock_ready.meaning: Calibration schedules run end to end through the Stage 2 ledger with the in-process mock executor and through the real Docker topology with the local mock model; every record is synthetic

blockers.detail: the candidate container runs /opt/stage26/mock_agent.py in python:3.11-slim; no code path starts the agent runtime rkmcp-codex-runtime:codex-0.163.0 inside the isolated topology
the gateway tunnels api.openai.com:443 only to the local /opt/stage26/mock_model_server.py; OPENAI_API_KEY is withheld from every container and nothing injects a real credential outside the candidate
25 of 25 scheduled tasks need the R scorer container, which the live runner does not run; they could only produce infrastructure failures

calibration_authorized.detail: No owner-approved spend ceiling is recorded (schedule model_execution_authorized=false). Authorization would require --authorize-spend plus an explicit ceiling, and is moot while the live executor is not ready

confirmatory_ready.detail: 0 S1 tasks; at most 8 after calibration (RC only; the 17 S2 controls cannot qualify) and 14 if the Q scorers are also revised, against a preregistered minimum of 30

feasibility.resolution: Add new, independently specified target tasks (S1 by task text), or amend the preregistration through a documented, dated protocol change made before any confirmatory data are seen. The threshold is not lowered to pass a gate.

gates.name: Offline Research Infrastructure
gates.prerequisites: Frozen digests, manifest, statistical tests, synthetic dry runs, unit test suite
gates.verification_command: pytest tests/test_stage2_validity.py tests/test_stage2_artifacts.py tests/test_stage26_live_runner.py tests/test_stage27_calibration.py -m 'not docker' && python -m benchmarks.codex_r.studies.stage2_validity_v1.cli frozen --verify

gates.name: Docker Experiment Infrastructure (mock model only)
gates.prerequisites: Docker --internal, CONNECT forward proxy allowlist, mock model server, non-root candidate user, canary probe enforcement, leftover sweeping
gates.remaining_blockers: Covers the mock model and mock agent only; it is not evidence of a real-model executor (gate 3)

gates.name: Baseline Model Calibration Execution
gates.prerequisites: A real-model executor inside the isolated topology, scorer-container integration for the scheduled tasks, an owner-approved spend ceiling, and execution of the 75 scheduled Arm A trials
gates.actual_evidence: 0 model calls executed; live mode refuses before any side effect

gates.name: Three-Arm Pilot Execution
gates.prerequisites: Completion of Gate 3 calibration, pilot budget approval, 90 planned trials (A/B/C)
gates.verification_command: none: no pilot execution command exists
gates.actual_evidence: Pilot specification prepared (90 trials); 0 model calls executed
gates.remaining_blockers: Gate 3, the same live-executor blockers, and budget approval

gates.name: Confirmatory Experiment Eligibility
gates.prerequisites: At least 30 qualified tasks in S1_confirmatory_core (Arm A mean in [0.10, 0.90], zero BEN-002 coupling), frozen registration commit
gates.actual_evidence: 0 S1 tasks; at most 8 after calibration (RC only; the 17 S2 controls cannot qualify) and 14 if the Q scorers are also revised, against a preregistered minimum of 30
gates.remaining_blockers: Not reachable with the current catalogue: at least 16 new target tasks even in the best case (realistically more, after calibration attrition)
